name: DGS 4234
title: Diagnostic Molecular Technologies
description: DNA and RNA diagnostic technologies used in clinical settings; clinical applications in prenatal diagnosis; cancer management, transplantation, paternity testing, forensic medicine and microbiology.
requirement_description: MCB 2400 or 2410; AH 3121 or MCB 4211 (which may be taken concurrently); open to students in DGS & MLS Programs, others w/ instructor consent. May not be taken out of sequence after passing DGS 4235, 4503, 4510, 4511, 4514, 4515, 4550.
